title: TinyML & Edge AI
tagline: Shrink models and run them on microcontrollers, phones, and small boards: pruning, quantization, distillation, TFLite Micro, Edge Impulse, ONNX, and ExecuTorch.
prereqs: Deep Learning (training a CNN in PyTorch or Keras). Hardware steps use a microcontroller board such as an ESP32-CAM or Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense, a Jetson, or a Raspberry Pi; the rest run on a laptop.
